changelog: Major Rewrite: Rebuilt from the ground up as a 100% native Android app in Kotlin & Jetpack Compose (replacing legacy v2.4.0 WebView).
Two Editions: Now available as NIMIYO YTDLP (com.nimiyo.dl) and Nimiyo Lite (com.nimiyo.dllite), installable side-by-side.
Performance & Stability: Fixed media player bugs, excessive resource usage, overheating, and MixTools audio stuttering.
Nimiyo YTDLP: Powered by built-in yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and aria2c with 1000+ platform support, Cookie Vault, and QuickSave Direct/Analyze mode.
Nimiyo Lite: Ultra-lightweight (~3.7 MB) Kotlin scraper engine with default server selector and QuickSave auto-close toggle + settings shortcut.

Music Player & Lyrics: Added Pause On, Resume On, Always Play On, Volume Boost, Playlist Button, Echo in MixTools Reverb, and Lyrics Styling (Custom Media Image/GIF/WebP/Video backdrop, Solid Black, Album Blur, custom fonts).
Download History: Added media type filter tabs (Audio, Video, Image) and upgraded built-in media player.
